provenance.author: Isaiah Jassen Tupal (2023)
provenance.training: TensorFlow.js CPU temporal CNN with a sixth "other" class; fixed seeds; deterministic order and augmentation; selected on calibration loss only
provenance.augmentation: Training rows only: ±15° in-plane rotation, mirroring, depth scale 0.8–1.2, 0.03 landmark jitter, ±2-row timing shift. 7 copies per number clip, 1 per other clip.
provenance.splitter: Numbers: original training CSV, first 12 clips by filename train, remaining 4 calibrate. Other: Six–Ten remaining training clips plus 3 train / 2 calibrate from even-ID FSL-105 signs; odd-ID signs are test-only. Webcam: newest session (or FSL_WEBCAM_HOLDOUT) test-only; elsewhere every fourth check calibrates. Original test clips untouched by this script.
provenance.consentRecords: FSL-105 reused under its published CC BY license. Webcam checks are Jim’s own landmarks recorded on this Mac.

limitations: Clip-disjoint, NOT signer-independent validation. No proven webcam generalization or signing-correctness feedback.
Single visible hand, source coordinate XYZ wrist centering and palm scaling; idle edges cropped and active window resampled. No pose/face or full FSL grammar.
No expert validation or endorsement of this classifier.
